title: All-resolution normalized direct-image cohomology roof
statement: For small ringed sites C,D with finite limits, a covering-preserving continuous finite-limit-preserving u:C→D presenting a morphism of sites, rings R,Rprime and rho:R→u_*Rprime, and module categories with enough injectives, let h:M→u_*N. For terminal X and u(X) and each natural q there exists hH:R^q Gamma_C(M)→R^q Gamma_D(N). For every injective resolution IM,IN a nonnegative termwise-injective replacement lam:u_*IN→L exists which is monic termwise and a quasi-isomorphism, together with b:IM→L strictly extending h. For every such replacement and lift, H^q(Gamma_C(lam)) is invertible and hH followed by the canonical target resolution comparison and H^q(Gamma_C(lam)) equals the canonical source comparison followed by H^q(Gamma_C(b)). This statement uses no Cech covers, edges or refinement maps. Notation: sites and their evaluation functors are [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]; module categories are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; injective resolutions are [def-sp-injective-resolutions].

proof.text: Choose a nonnegative termwise monic injective replacement of the termwise direct image of IN, using the bounded-below complex resolution with bound zero. Strictly extend the coefficient augmentation along IM to this replacement.

proof.text: Evaluation is additive and left exact. The direct image terms are evaluation-acyclic by direct-image injective evaluation acyclicity; the replacement terms are acyclic by injective vanishing. Leray acyclicity makes evaluation of lam a quasi-isomorphism. Define hH by the inverse of its homology map and the two canonical resolution comparisons.

source.place: 08J6 (remark-before-Leray), together with derived.tex 013K, 013P, 013S and 015E; refinement-square proof steps 2, 4 and 8.

proof.text: For another replacement lift its map strictly along the first lam. The composites with the two source lifts agree on M, hence are homotopic. Evaluation preserves that homotopy and cancellation identifies their roofs. For a different target resolution, push forward a strict resolution comparison, which is a homotopy equivalence, then lift this map to the two replacements; the same homotopy argument and target comparison naturality identify the maps. For a different source resolution use a strict comparison over M and its canonical homology identity. These three comparisons give the claimed equation for every resolution pair and replacement.

theorem ringedSite_resolution_roof
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D]
    (J : Precoverage C) (K : Precoverage D)
    [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition] [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    [K.HasIsos] [K.IsStableUnderComposition] [K.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [K.HasPullbacks]
    (u : C ⥤ D) [PreservesFiniteLimits u]
    (hcover : ∀ (Y : C) (S : Presieve Y), S ∈ J Y → S.map u ∈ K (u.obj Y))
    [u.IsContinuous J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback u (Type u) J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (sheafPullback u (Type u) J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck)]
    (R : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck RingCat.{u}) (R' : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck RingCat.{u})
    (ρ : R ⟶ (u.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u}
      J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck).obj R')
    [EnoughInjectives (ringedSiteModules.{u} R)]
    [EnoughInjectives (ringedSiteModules.{u} R')]
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} R) (N : ringedSiteModules.{u} R')
    (h : M ⟶ (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).obj N)
    {X : C} (hX : IsTerminal X) (huX : IsTerminal (u.obj X))
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ hH : (((SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj) ⋙ (evaluation
              Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op X)).rightDerived q).obj M ⟶ (((SheafOfModules.forget R'
              ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R'.obj) ⋙ (evaluation Dᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op
              (u.obj X))).rightDerived q).obj N,
              (∀ (IM : InjectiveResolution M) (IN : InjectiveResolution N),
                ∃ (L : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u} R) ℕ)
                  (lam : ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up
                    ℕ)).obj IN.cocomplex ⟶ L)
                  (b : IM.cocomplex ⟶ L),
                  (∀ n : ℕ, Injective (L.X n)) ∧
                  (∀ n : ℕ, Mono (lam.f n)) ∧ QuasiIso lam ∧
                  IM.ι.f 0 ≫ b.f 0 = h ≫ (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).map (IN.ι.f 0) ≫ lam.f
                    0) ∧
              (∀ (IM : InjectiveResolution M) (IN : InjectiveResolution N)
                (L : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u} R) ℕ)
                (lam : ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up
                  ℕ)).obj IN.cocomplex ⟶ L)
                (b : IM.cocomplex ⟶ L),
                (∀ n : ℕ, Injective (L.X n)) →
                (∀ n : ℕ, Mono (lam.f n)) → QuasiIso lam →
                IM.ι.f 0 ≫ b.f 0 = h ≫ (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).map (IN.ι.f 0) ≫ lam.f 0 →
                IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((((SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙
                  PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj) ⋙ (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op
                  X)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map lam) q) ∧
                hH ≫ (IN.isoRightDerivedObj ((SheafOfModules.forget R' ⋙
                  PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R'.obj) ⋙ (evaluation Dᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op
                  (u.obj X))) q).hom ≫
                  HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((((SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙
                    PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj) ⋙ (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op
                    X)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map lam) q =
                (IM.isoRightDerivedObj ((SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
                  R.obj) ⋙ (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op X)) q).hom ≫
                  HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((((SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙
                    PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj) ⋙ (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op
                    X)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map b) q)
